source.title: 2021 Salary Resolutions (2021-01-05 Town Board - Full Minutes, CivicClerk)

note: Board-authorized annual salaries set by resolutions 2021-5 through 2021-12. Schedules carried here: Boards, Elected Officials, General Fund, Highway, Police, Sewer / Scavenger Waste, Street Lighting, Water District. This is authorized pay, not actual pay, and it is the schedule as adopted in January: a mid-year salary resolution changes what a position is paid without changing this file.
